note_text: Abdomen ultrasonography. Liver: diffusely increased parenchymal echogenicity with mild posterior attenuation, compatible with mild hepatic steatosis. Liver contour smooth. Spleen normal in size. No focal hepatic lesion. Gallbladder and bile ducts unremarkable. Impression: 경도 지방간.

Outpatient note. Hepatic steatosis on ultrasound (mild); diagnosed as metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) (formerly NAFLD). BMI 28.7. Alcohol intake by history below the threshold for the diagnosis. Cardiometabolic risk: HTN, dyslipidemia, obesity. FIB-4 2.14 (indeterminate), APRI 0.71. Lifestyle modification counselled; FibroScan scheduled.

Transient elastography (FibroScan). Liver stiffness measurement 8.4 kPa (IQR/median 22%, 10 valid measurements), CAP 256 dB/m. Interpretation: LSM compatible with significant fibrosis (F2 range); CAP in the S1 steatosis range.
Outpatient follow-up. FibroScan LSM 8.4 kPa, CAP 256 dB/m reviewed. Start semaglutide 0.25 mg SC weekly for obesity/overweight with BMI 28.5; escalate every 4 weeks to 2.4 mg.

Follow-up visit, 6 months after diagnosis. Weight 71.0 kg (BMI 26.9; -6.2% from baseline). AST/ALT 44/32 U/L, platelets 191 x10^3/uL, FIB-4 2.16. Semaglutide 2.4 mg SC weekly continued. Lifestyle therapy continued (target weight loss 7-10%).
